data.title: 法琳 · 破口已经快看不见了
data.description: 傍晚的窗边，针已经收进布包。法琳把补好的旅行毯摊在膝上，轻轻抚平那道细密的针脚，身后的庭院渐渐暗下来。
data.promptProse: Falin sits on an inn window seat in a slate-blue knitted cardigan and long brown skirt. A mended travel blanket lies across her knees; she smooths its repaired seam while the needle is already stored in a cloth sewing kit beside her. A small lamp warms the room as the courtyard outside turns blue at dusk.
data.animaCaption: Her empty hand smooths the stitched blanket; the sewing needle remains stored in the closed kit.
data.action: 抚平旅行毯的补缝，针已收进布包
data.mood: 收好一天事务后的安心
